cards.label: Whitechapel
cards.text: Whitechapel keeps its grief the way other places keep street furniture — permanent, load-bearing, mostly ignored. You feel it anyway, a low hum under the emotion-type in your bag.
It passes, the way all inherited grief eventually does — not gone, just filed. The emotion-type in your bag sits heavier when you stand up, like it's been listening the whole time.
